subject: Novatix demo slot — releasing due to roadmap reprioritization
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novatix.com>
Cc: Novatix Product Team <product@novatix.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Novatix demo — proposed walkthrough (Jan 20)

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for taking the time last week to chat through Novatix's search + recommendations use case. Per our conversation, I set aside a 45-minute slot tomorrow (Jan 20, 10:00 AM PST) to demo an inference flow that mirrors the performance and cost/levers you'd be most sensitive to.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick context and success metrics you care about (5 min)
- Live demo: Redwood inference runtime + cost controls (20 min)
- Q&A and next steps (15 min)

I attached a short mutual action plan so your team can see what we typically cover during a pilot and what resources we need from Novatix. If that time doesn't work, here's my Calendly link to pick another slot: https://calendly.com/jordan-blake/novatix-demo-30

Look forward to it — happy to trim the agenda if you prefer a shorter sync.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: Novatix-MAP-v1.pdf
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novatix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novatix Product Team <product@novatix.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novatix demo — proposed walkthrough (Jan 20)

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the follow-up and the MAP. I wanted to flag a change on our side: leadership just did a short roadmap reset and we are deprioritizing new LLM pilots this quarter while we focus engineering bandwidth on the payments migration and two enterprise integrations.

Given that, can you release the Jan 20 slot? We still think the work you're doing is interesting — this is a prioritization call rather than a product fit decision — but we won't be able to run a pilot or dedicate engineers until at least Q3.

Also, I (and a few folks on the product team) will be traveling week of Jan 26 and then deep in planning through February, so any demo this month becomes tough to staff. If you want to keep the MAP for when we reengage, that's fine.

Sorry for the churn — we should be in a better position to revisit in late Q2 / early Q3.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Product, Novatix
ethan.cole@novatix.com

---
Novatix Product Team added as recipient
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novatix.com>
Cc: Novatix Product Team <product@novatix.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novatix demo — proposed walkthrough (Jan 20)

Thanks for the heads up, Ethan — understood and totally reasonable.

We'll release the Jan 20 slot and pause active scheduling. A couple of offers to make reengagement easier when you're ready:
- I'll keep the MAP and demo recording template updated for you;
- If it helps, we can keep a sandbox environment running (read-only) for your PMs to poke at — no engineering time required;
- We're prepared to offer a small reactivation credit if you want to run a short pilot once Novatix reopens the workstream (I can confirm details with our CS manager).

I'll check back in early July to see where things land. If your team thinks an intro-level 20m sync is still useful while you're traveling (purely product context, no setup required), we can do that as well — otherwise I'll follow your lead and reconnect mid-year.

Safe travels to your team.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Novatix demo — releasing slot (DEAL-1897)

Marissa / Monica — forwarding the note from Novatix. They reprioritized the quarter and asked us to release the Jan 20 demo. No pushback on product fit; they flagged travel + payments migration as the blocker.

My thinking: keep them in the nurture queue and offer a modest reactivation credit or short Dedicated trial offer so when they return to pilots we have a clear value exchange. Recommended next steps:
- Marissa: can you draft a short reactivation offer (credit + 90-day trial parameters) I can use in outreach?
- Monica: please add a HubSpot task to follow up on 2026-07-06 and tag marketing for a one-off reengagement play; link the MAP to the record.

I'll update DEAL-1897 notes and release the calendar slot.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Ethan —

Per your note, we're releasing the Jan 20 demo slot and will stash the MAP in your HubSpot record (DEAL-1897). I created a follow-up task for July 6 to check back in; HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/novatix-DEAL-1897
